blurb: Guests fly in a helicopter piloted by certified pilots, experiencing aerial views of South Padre Island, SpaceX Starbase, ship graveyards, and fireworks. Flights accommodate up to three passengers plus the pilot, with no age limit and weight restrictions per seat and total passengers.
